name: io.github.ibtsam2666/playwright-rerun-mcp
description: List, explain and rerun failed Playwright tests, or rerun them by test-case ID.

environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_PROJECT_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Playwright project to run (default: the current directory)

environmentVariables.name: RERUN_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Stop a test run after this many milliseconds (default 600000)
